summary: scripts/review asks for answers only after a CHANGES: a later round that follows a GO, such as a merge of main that resolved a conflict or a carried GO from round 2 or 3, validates without answers instead of failing every time

replay.detail: A review script change only; no replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes; the verdict schema is unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No protocol or API change. scripts/review passes the earlier verdict only to a base validator that takes one, so an older base keeps its old rule.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
